channel.description: Russian aerial strikes snarl traffic on 3 Kyiv bridges in a new disruption tactic

item.title: Supreme Court will hear dispute over a Kentucky church's plan to build a shrine on residential land
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to consider whether a religious institution has a right to build a shrine to the Virgin Mary on residential property next to its Kentucky church

item.title: New ICE guidance bans high-speed car chases and sets tighter rules for traffic stops, a memo shows
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers have been ordered not to engage in high-speed car chases and to conduct vehicle stops only after completing specific training

item.title: DC judge permanently dismisses case charging ex-Olympian with vandalizing Reflecting Pool
item.description: A judge in Washington has agreed to permanently dismiss a criminal case charging a former Olympian with vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool

item.title: Supreme Court denies Arizona’s bid to delay start of takeover of healthcare in state prisons
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a bid by Arizona to block the start of a court-ordered takeover of healthcare operations in its prisons after the state was found to have provided inadequate care to incarcerated people and dragged its feet in making improvements

item.title: Federal report says pilots weren't warned about wind before Amazon cargo plane crashed in Miami
item.description: An air traffic controller failed to warn pilots of an Amazon cargo plane about the potential for strong tail winds before it crashed in Miami, killing five people

item.title: A new Trump proposal would require tax filers to disclose citizenship status to the IRS
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed a change to the 1040 tax form that will require Americans to disclose their citizenship and residency status

item.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over possible risks to consumers
item.description: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has opened an investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic and other artificial intelligence companies over dangers their technology may pose to consumers, the agency said Wednesday

item.title: Wes Moore forms bipartisan governors group on AI, citing federal inaction
item.description: Gov. Wes Moore of Maryland is forming a bipartisan group of governors to address concerns about artificial intelligence

item.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signs laws to protect workers from AI risks
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has signed laws aimed at protecting workers from the risks of artificial intelligence

item.title: Hurricane Rachel strengthens to a Category 3 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast
item.description: Hurricane Rachel has been upgraded to a Category 3 storm off Mexico’s Pacific coast, according to the National Hurricane Center

item.title: Dual UK-Iranian national arrested over security incident at US-run air base in England
item.description: British police have arrested a dual UK-Iranian national on suspicion of plotting a terror attack following a security incident at a U.S.-run air base on the weekend

item.title: Nepal avalanche toll rises to 15 deaths with discovery of 8 bodies on Mount Himlung
item.description: Rescuers have discovered eight bodies at the base camp of Mount Himlung in Nepal

item.title: A plumber and a dentist are praised as heroes in FlyDubai near-disaster
item.description: A plumber, a dentist and others are being hailed as heroes after a dramatic incident on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv

item.title: A 21-year-old Fortnite pro gives out computers to young gamers and plans for more through a new fund
item.description: Cody Conrod wants to help others enter the increasingly expensive world of professional gaming after he dropped out of eighth grade to pursue esports

item.title: Russian aerial strikes snarl traffic on 3 Kyiv bridges in a new disruption tactic
item.description: Russian aerial attacks have forced the partial closure of three bridges over the Dnipro River in Kyiv, causing traffic chaos
